description:
This process begins when a customer places an order through an online platform or over the phone.
The system automatically generates an order confirmation and sends it to the customer.
The warehouse team picks and packs the items, and a shipping label is generated.
The order is then handed over to a logistics provider for delivery.
Tracking information is sent to the customer.
The process continues as the shipment is monitored until it reaches the customer's address.
After successful delivery, the process ends, but customer feedback or returns may trigger further actions.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"

                  id="Definitions_OrderFulfillment"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/order-fulfillment">

  <bpmn:message id="Message_OrderConfirmation" name="Order confirmation"/>

  <bpmn:message id="Message_Return" name="Return"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OrderFulfillment">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Order fulfillment" processRef="Process_OrderFulfillment"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LogisticsProvider" name="Logistics provider"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Order" name="Customer order" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_Order" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Confirmation" name="Order confirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_OrderConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Handover" name="Shipment handover" sourceRef="Task_HandoverShipment" targetRef="Participant_LogisticsProvider" messageRef="Message_ShipmentHandover"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Tracking" name="Tracking information" sourceRef="Task_SendTracking" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_TrackingInformation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Feedback" name="Customer feedback" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_Feedback" messageRef="Message_CustomerFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Return" name="Return" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_Return" messageRef="Message_Return"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OrderFulfillment" name="Order fulfillment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Order" name="Customer places order">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Order" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrderChannel" name="Order channel"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ChannelMerge" name="Continue order fulfillment"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateConfirmation" name="Generate order confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Send order confirmation" messageRef="Message_OrderConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PickItems" name="Pick items"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PackItems" name="Pack items"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateShippingLabel" name="Generate shipping label"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_HandoverShipment" name="Hand over shipment to logistics provider" messageRef="Message_ShipmentHandover"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTracking" name="Send tracking information" messageRef="Message_TrackingInformation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MonitorShipment" name="Monitor shipment"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DeliveryReached" name="Shipment reached customer's address?"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_SuccessfulDelivery" name="Shipment reaches customer's address"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_SuccessfulDelivery" name="Successfully delivered"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderToChannel" sourceRef="Start_Order" targetRef="Gateway_OrderChannel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OnlineOrder" name="Online platform" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderChannel" targetRef="Gateway_ChannelMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">orderChannel = "online"</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PhoneOrder" name="Phone" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderChannel" targetRef="Gateway_ChannelMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">orderChannel = "phone"</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChannelToGenerate" sourceRef="Gateway_ChannelMerge" targetRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GenerateToSend" sourceRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendToPick" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Task_PickItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PickToPack" sourceRef="Task_PickItems" targetRef="Task_PackItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PackToLabel" sourceRef="Task_PackItems" targetRef="Task_GenerateShippingLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LabelToHandover" sourceRef="Task_GenerateShippingLabel" targetRef="Task_HandoverShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HandoverToTracking" sourceRef="Task_HandoverShipment" targetRef="Task_SendTracking"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrackingToMonitor" sourceRef="Task_SendTracking" targetRef="Task_MonitorShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MonitorToCheck" sourceRef="Task_MonitorShipment" targetRef="Gateway_DeliveryReached"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DeliveryReached" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_DeliveryReached" targetRef="Event_SuccessfulDelivery">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">shipmentReachedAddress = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DeliveryNotReached" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_DeliveryReached" targetRef="Task_MonitorShipment">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">shipmentReachedAddress = false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SuccessToEnd" sourceRef="Event_SuccessfulDelivery" targetRef="End_SuccessfulDelivery"/>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Feedback" name="Further actions on customer feedback" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Feedback" name="Customer feedback received" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Feedback" messageRef="Message_CustomerFeedback"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_FurtherActionFeedback" name="Take further action on customer feedback"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Feedback" name="Feedback actions complete"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackToAction" sourceRef="Start_Feedback" targetRef="Task_FurtherActionFeedback"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackActionToEnd" sourceRef="Task_FurtherActionFeedback" targetRef="End_Feedback"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Return" name="Further actions on returns" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Return" name="Return received" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Return" messageRef="Message_Return"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_FurtherActionReturn" name="Take further action on return"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Return" name="Return actions complete"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReturnToAction" sourceRef="Start_Return" targetRef="Task_FurtherActionReturn"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReturnActionToEnd" sourceRef="Task_FurtherActionReturn" targetRef="End_Return"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
